parameters.content:
## Inactive setup template — review before use
1. Configure Webhook Header Auth: X-Lab-Webhook-Token with your own secret.
2. Configure OpenAI HTTP Header Auth: Authorization = Bearer YOUR_KEY (in credentials only).
3. Replace CONFIGURE_MODEL with an available model ID.
4. Configure SMTP credentials, sender and your own test recipient.
5. Test with synthetic data, inspect output, then activate only when ready.
Webhook acceptance does not prove email delivery. No credentials are included.
